nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to read the complete nutrition-guidelines page at `http://localhost:30206/guidelines.html` with read-only browser operations. Return the exact lunch targets for calories, protein, fat, and carbohydrates, every reported dietary restriction/note, and page/table/field controls.

explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 1): Use one strictly read-only explore sub-agent to query exact recipe category `荤菜`. If the response is materialized as an overlong runtime `output_path`, read that file from the task workspace instead of retrying the category call. Select at least two distinct cafeteria-suitable recipe IDs, retrieve only those exact IDs in native parallel, and return `{recipes:[{recipe_id,name,category,ingredients,preparation}], category:"荤菜", category_result_count, selected_count, duplicate_ids, missing_fields}`. Do not write a deliverable or modify a recipe.
